blocks.content: Course: Learn React Zustand: The Smarter Way to Handle Data
In Zustand, we keep data and functions in a store.
The store is the heart of Zustand. It is a JavaScript object that holds your state and the functions that can change it. Any component in your app can read from it or update it directly.
In Zustand you create a store using one function called create. That is it.
One function. Let us see what it looks like.
Next, you will write your first store. Click Next Lesson to continue.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
